Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4143; a boat:--boat, little (small) ship.
BiblicalUsage: Ploiarion is a little boat, a small ship. The crowd took shipping in little boats to seek Jesus in John 6:24, and the disciples came in a little ship dragging the net in John 21:8. Jesus asked for a small ship to keep the crowd from pressing Him in Mark 3:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus used a little boat the way He uses little things — to get close enough to be heard.
